findings.location: What the counterexample shows / sole bullet, broader bare-isomorphism conclusion and “missing input is exactly”
findings.evidence: The witness proves that the regular word-projective class is a nonunit multiple of the lower vector. The owned counterexample was repaired to refute the word-projective assertion; this read-only page retains the broader inference.
